what: Product and category card rows that overflow horizontally — pushing by hand snaps to the card start with scroll-snap, and pressing Prev or Next in the label row moves one card at a time. The duration scales with the distance as 300 + 300·√(distance/total row width) ms (about .37s for one card), with an outQuad curve. The button on the side with nowhere left to go turns a faded text color. When a horizontal wheel reaches the end of the row, it is blocked from leaking into the back-navigation gesture

options.base: Base duration (s), default .3 — 0 means only the distance-proportional share
options.span: Distance-proportional share (seconds) — multiplied by √(distance/total width), default .3
options.[data-fx-part=track] · [data-fx-part=pre: Row holding the cells (required) · previous and next buttons (optional)
options.--fx-flex · --fx-gap: Cell width and gap (via style), default 5 cells · 1px — on phone like calc(100% / 1.3)
options.--fx-off: Text color of the button on the side that can go no further, default --kf-dim
options.fx:prev · fx:next: Sent to an element, it moves one step. Each move fires fx:step(detail.index)

from.where: index.html .ib-row (three product rows · 5 columns with 1px gaps) · .ib-cats (category row · 99px gap) — original FeatureSlider (scroll-snap x mandatory, duration natural · easing outQuad)
